lines.en: In the village of Buf I was travelling,
in the middle of the field.
I met a beautiful girl,
a fairy, alone in the field.
Ilinka, my girl, my love,
sunlight in the middle of the river,
and my thoughts travel
over the mountains to the blue sky.

lines.cyr: Срце ми се смири, в' душа топлина,
lines.lat: Srce mi se smiri, v' duša toplina,
lines.en: My heart grew calm, warmth in my soul,

lines.cyr: сакам да ми бидеш Буфска невеста.
lines.lat: sakam da mi bideš Bufska nevesta.
lines.en: I want you to be my Buf bride.
She was a beautiful girl,
like the wind and cold water,
she would wash and braid
her golden hair.
Ilinka, my girl, my love,
sunlight in the middle of the river,
and my thoughts travel
over the mountains to the blue sky.
